name: SaaS Landing Page

sources.title: Homepage — curated gallery of 840 SaaS landing page examples by Davide Pacilio; sponsored cards marked 'Sponsored'; Advertise → slpads.framer.website
Advertise on SaaS Landing Page — 'Submit your product, and we'll be in touch within 24-48 hours'; sponsorship inquiry form

requirements: No self-serve free submission — the gallery is editor-curated; the only inbound route is the sponsorship contact form
Fit: a SaaS with a genuinely well-designed landing page; entries are page-level showcases (landing, pricing, about, features, blog, testimonials, FAQ, contact pages)
Sponsorship = paid placement ('Sponsored' tag shown on paid entries like Mobbin, Humblytics)
preparation: Your live SaaS landing page URL
A short pitch of the product for the contact form
Budget for a sponsorship slot — pricing is discussed off-page (24-48h reply promise)
workflow: Submit the product details via the sponsorship form
Wait for their reply (24-48h) with sponsorship options and pricing
If featured, your site gets a gallery card + detail page at saaslandingpage.com/<slug>/
watchFor: This is an editorial design gallery — there is no free 'submit your site' form
Sponsored entries are labeled 'Sponsored' — the backlink is a sponsorship artifact
The contact form lives on a Framer-hosted subdomain (slpads.framer.website), not the main domain
Organic curation happens without submission — if your page is exceptional they may feature it on their own
countsAsLive: Your site appears as a gallery card with a detail page on saaslandingpage.com (marked 'Sponsored' if paid)
unknowns: Whether they accept unsolicited free submissions via the form
Dofollow status of gallery outbound links
